Name: Phil
Dialog: Oh, boy! Did that kid stink or what? But maybe YOU'VE got what it takes to be

Name: Candace
Dialog: Auditions! Today?!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Yes, today! At two o'clock sharp.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grabs the TV and kisses it) I gotta tell Stacy! (Runs, bringing the TV with her and falls)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That pop star stuff might be fun at first, but then you'd be stuck with a dead end job. Too bad you can't just do it once and move on.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, what you're talking about is a one-hit wonder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One-hit wonder? What's that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, a musical act goes to the top of the charts with a catchy tune and meaningless lyrics.

Name: Singers and Lindana
Dialog: Fun fun fun!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (voiceover) Then they throw a big diva tantrum, lose their label, then fade to obscurity. Before they know it, their song ends up as

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (writing) A one-hit wonder... (Shows checklist, listing in order

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Stacy, what am I going to sing?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello, what are you gonna wear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Too much. (Candace wears a bikini; now offscreen.) Too little. (Candace wears a pinafore.) Ugh, too clean. (Candace wears torn cords and a hippie t-shirt.) Too dirty. (Candace wears a street clothing.) Too street. (Candace wears a goth suit.) Too goth. (Cut to her.) Where'd you get that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: My mom's closet. You like it?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Nah, too retro.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Perfect!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice, huh?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, you should've tried that on first.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: "Chika, chika, choo...wah". Meaningless lyrics done. How's the catchy tune coming along?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Excellent! We'll be done by lunch! Hey, where'd Perry go?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello? Hello-oo? Anybody there?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, good morning Agent P. We just received word that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up construction toys at an alarming rate. We need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it.

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll meet back in the entrance in an hour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Stacy! We gotta hurry so we could get a spot in li -- yayaya. (realized the line's too long) I've never sang in front of so many people!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? (shows her a LOT more people in the audience)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I can't do this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh yes, you can! You're not a quitter; you're a fighter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sure you are! You're a lean, mean, singing machine!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: That's it, yeah! Now you're looking like a winner!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (arranges herself) And that is what a gorilla looks like when you try to take away its food. Oh! Hi, Jeremy! Are you auditioning too?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nah. I came to see this hot new band called PFT. I downloaded their song this morning. It's tight! The hundredth contestant gets to sing onstage with the band!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? (She walks through the entrance and becomes the 100th contestant.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, looks like that's you.

Name: Phil
Dialog: Congratulations! You're the hundredth contestant! (Pulls her away)

Name: Phil
Dialog: (over speaker) Ladies and gentlemen, this young lady has the honor of singing onstage with PFT. So now, the band you've been waiting for

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? You're the hundredth contestant? How serendipitous. This'll be like a brother and sister thing! Now I'm assuming you've heard our hit single. I mean, who hasn't, right? It's a big hit. (gives her sheet music) So here's the words; don't worry if you get lost. The lyrics are meaningless anyway. I'll point when it's your turn.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, the Ferbettes! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb, and we're gonna sing a song!

Name: Ferbettes
Dialog: Never gonna stop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute! What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm cuing you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: How'd you get a hit single?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it wasn't easy. It took most of the morning and half a dozen phone calls. But if you're willing to put in the work-

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! I'm gonna tell Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay...tell her what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pauses) Ooh, I'm just gonna tell.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom, you've gotta see this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) Let me guess. Is it unbelieva- (Candace pushes her) WOOAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Ben Baxter
Dialog: Hi, I'm Ben Baxter, Huge-O-Records. Why don't you come by my office in an hour and we can talk about your future.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Future? Cool. He must be a psychic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! (They arrive at the stage; she presents a shadow that appears to be Phineas and Ferb's heads.) See?! There they are onstage!!!

Name: Announcer
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, once again... (Spotlight lights up.) Marty the Rabbit Boy and His Musical Blender!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, we're getting you an eye exam. (pulls her away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Wait!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha, everything is ready!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (doorbell rings) Oh, what is it now? (opens the door and saw the disguised Perry) Oh, are you my new temp? Well, let me just get you up the speed. I know it's bit of a mess. I'm just putting the finishing touches of my latest maniacal plan. You see, in a few minutes, I will unleash an unprecedented reign of terror upon the entire... (holds a magnifying glass on the eastern coast of the U.S.) ...Tri-State Area! And Perry the Platypus will never be the wiser.(Perry removes the Groucho glasses) Perry the Platypus? You're a temp? Are times that hard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! I told Mom I don't need glasses! (takes off glasses) What the --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, No! No! Wait! Uggggg...

Name: Candace
Dialog: MMMMMOOOOM?!?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry, Perry the Platypus, but you are too late! (pushes a lever that makes the building alive as a robot)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (wearing a jacket) Ooh, this one's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Come here! You've gotta see this! (drags her out, setting off the shoplifting alarm)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace! I haven't payed for this yet!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha ha! When it comes to havoc, nobody wreaks like me!(Perry removes a metal cover of a storage) Wait, wait, wait, you're not supposed to touch that! (Perry removes a wire)Hey, hey, no fair!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, what a great painting! How did you get permission for that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, they didn't mind. The building's scheduled for demolition.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seeeeeee??!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHHHH!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Uh, ma'am, you're gonna have to come back and pay for that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Yes of course, officer.

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAAAHHHH!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey, weren't you Lindana?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, I was! I can't believe you recognized me.

Name: Guard
Dialog: Well, I was a huge fan. (pauses, serious) You still have to pay for the jacket.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) I know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus. I tried to ignore you, but you forced my hand.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And now...I shall relax with a nice, tasty deli platter. Oh-ho-ho, where are my manners?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Gives Perry his share) Here you go, Perry the Platypus. Care for some pepper? Just say when. (Continues to pour pepper) Anytime.

Name: Ben
Dialog: (from inside) Boys, let me start by saying we love your act and we want to be... (cuts to the boardroom) ...in the Phineas and the Ferb-Tones business. And by the way, aren't you a little young to be pop stars?

Name: Ben
Dialog: Well, okay then! We prepared to offer you a very lucrative contract if you'll just sign exclusively with us for your follow-up single.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (suddenly angry) Follow-up single? (rips up the contract under the following) Who do you think we are, some two-bit hacks who will keep writing new songs just because you pay us obscene amounts of cash?! Phineas and the Ferb-Tones are strictly a one-hit wonder! (The band enters the elevator) Good day to you, sir!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Diva tantrum, check. (Pauses, listens to the "Gitchee Gitchee Goo" elevator music) Elevator music, check.

Name: Ben
Dialog: Ah, who needs 'em? We still got this video tape of their performance. We could do live CDs, DVDs, pod-casts, heck, we can digitally re-create their images to make our own sitcom! The Phineas and Ferb Show! We could squeeze twenty years of entertainment out of this one video tape.

Name: Manager
Dialog: (screams) That giant robot's coming right at us!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (still pouring pepper) Wow, you sure like a lot of pepper. I'm more of a paprika man myself. (Perry blows over the pepper, Dr. D coughs) It will take more than condiments to foil my brilliant plan!

Name: Ben
Dialog: The tape!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAHHH!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: AAAAAAAAHHHHH!!! (Lands on a soft mattress) Ooh! What an unbelievable stroke of luck! (The mattress folds in half) Oof! I'm okay! I'm still better than the... (gets stepped over by the robot) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry chatters; a bus pulls up and they get on) Come on, guys. We still have one thing left to do.

Name: Phil
Dialog: And the winner of the day's "Next Super American Pop Teen Idol Star" is... (Screen zooms out to reveal

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What's wrong?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm better than that guy. Oh, I should've taken blender lessons.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So why did you run off earlier?

Name: Candace
Dialog: My brothers. (sighs) They always ruin everything.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, you like to sing, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Then you shouldn't let your brothers' fun ruin your good time. You know, if you get a chance to sing, you oughta sing. I gotta go, I'll see you later. (Walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey Candace. (Shows the stage for the PFT Reunion Concert) You're still the hundredth contestant, wanna come up and help us out?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was great! I've been thinking of my brothers all wrong! They're not a nuisance. They're my ticket to-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, you've been great! This is the last time we're ever gonna sing that song. We're retiring, good night!

Name: Mall Operator
Dialog: (via loud speaker) The mall is now closed and will re-open at 9

Name: Announcer
Dialog: You loved her in the '80s. Get ready to love her again. Lindana's mega hit "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun", and been remixed and re-translated into your favorite languages

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Whatcha watchin'?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, nothing.
